title: Rhubarb Crumble
description: A sweet and tangy dessert made with fresh rhubarb and topped with a crunchy crumble. Perfect for those with gluten intolerance.
instructions: Cut the rhubarb into 1-inch pieces and place in a 9x9-inch baking dish.
Mix the quick oats, nutty brown sugar, and Irish sugar in a bowl.
Add the unsalted butter to the bowl and mix until crumbly.
Spread the crumble mixture evenly over the rhubarb.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the topping is golden brown and the rhubarb is tender.
Serve warm with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream.
